doc_description: Checks whether team sessions in Planning Poker and Moving Motivators can connect from your network.
title: Network check
lead: Team sessions in Planning Poker and Moving Motivators travel through free public relays. This page tries each one from your network — office, home or VPN — and tells you which get through.
verdict.works.title: Team sessions will work on this network
verdict.works.body: Both transports are reachable. Sessions use MQTT brokers and Nostr relays at once.
verdict.nostr-only.title: Team sessions will work, over Nostr only
verdict.nostr-only.body: The MQTT ports are blocked here, but the Nostr relays on port 443 get through. Sessions still connect; late joiners catch up slightly more slowly.
verdict.mqtt-only.title: Team sessions will work, over MQTT only
verdict.mqtt-only.body: The Nostr relays are blocked here, but the MQTT brokers get through.
verdict.none.title: Team sessions can’t connect from this network
verdict.none.body: None of the relays the apps use answered. Solo mode still works. Send the results below to whoever maintains the toolkit.
notes.ports: MQTT brokers use ports 8884, 8084 and 8081, which corporate firewalls often block. Nostr relays use the standard web port 443.
notes.candidate: Relays marked “candidate” aren’t used by the apps yet; they’re checked to see whether adding them would help.
notes.privacy: Each check only opens a connection and asks the relay to answer. No session data is sent. As with any website, the relays see your IP address.
